description: This file contains unit tests for device management functionalities within the 'operator' package, including device registration, unregistration, testing device pools, pre-registration, and grouping functions.

methods.name: TestNewDevice
methods.description: Tests creation of a new device object, ensuring it is not nil.

methods.name: TestDeviceRegister
methods.description: Tests registering, unregistering, and messaging clients within a device.

methods.name: TestPoolRegister
methods.description: Tests registration and unregistration of devices within a device pool.

methods.name: TestPoolPreRegister
methods.description: Tests pre-registration, cancelation, and registration of pre-registered devices.

methods.name: TestListDevices
methods.description: Tests listing all device IDs after registration and unregistration.

methods.name: TestListDevicesByGroup
methods.description: Tests retrieving devices filtered by group ID.

methods.name: TestListDevicesEmpty
methods.description: Tests behavior of device lists when pool is empty.

methods.name: TestGroupIdFromPrivateData
methods.description: Tests extraction of group ID from device info.

methods.name: TestListGroups
methods.description: Tests listing distinct group IDs after device registration/unregistration.

methods.name: TestDefaultGroup
methods.description: Tests default group assignment and device counting per group.
